title: The Unsaid Silence
author: Freya Villalobos
blurb: Edmund Kavanagh, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
